title: Will Vanishes
description: While cycling home through Mirkwood after a D&D session, Will Byers is taken by the Demogorgon and dragged into the Upside Down.

title: Eleven Escapes Hawkins Lab
description: Subject 011 breaks free from Hawkins Lab after a traumatic sensory deprivation experiment goes wrong, using her powers to kill her guards.

title: The Party Finds Eleven
description: Mike, Dustin, and Lucas discover a shaved-head girl in the forest while searching for Will. She can only say her lab number: 'Eleven'.

title: Will Speaks Through the Lights
description: Joyce realizes Will is communicating with her through electrical disturbances. She strings Christmas lights across the wall and he spells out letters.

title: Barb Is Taken
description: Barbara Holland is dragged into the Upside Down by the Demogorgon while waiting at the Harrington pool. She does not survive.

title: Body Found at the Quarry
description: A body believed to be Will's is found in Sattler Quarry. Joyce refuses to believe it is real — she is right; it is a fake planted by the lab.

title: Hopper Infiltrates the Lab
description: Chief Hopper breaks into Hawkins Lab and discovers the Gate — a portal to the Upside Down — confirming that the government is hiding the truth about Will.

title: Eleven Locates Will
description: Using a makeshift sensory deprivation tank in the Hawkins Middle School gym, Eleven reaches out into the Void and finds Will alive in the Upside Down.

title: The Final Showdown
description: The Demogorgon attacks the Party in the Hawkins Middle School classroom. Eleven sacrifices herself to destroy the creature, disintegrating alongside it.

title: Will Is Rescued
description: Joyce and Hopper enter the Upside Down through the Gate at Hawkins Lab and pull Will's body free. He is resuscitated and returns home.
